tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250ye shes rab 'bar las: phrin las sngon 'gro phyi gtor 'dod don lhun grub bzhugs so: 1$0000300dbang drag he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: ྈྈྈྈྈ

ye shes rab 'bar zab mo'i lam bzang gi: phrin las rnam bzhi gang gi sngon 'gro ru: lha srin 'jig rten skyong bar las bcol ba'i: 'dod don skul byed yongs la gces phyir bkod: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: lha klu zhi ba'i rigs la dkar gtor dang: 'dre srin drag po'i rigs la dmar gtor dang: mi phyed spyi la 'bras chen ril bu sogs: ci dgyes 'dod 'byung sngags kyis byin gyis brlab: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su gtor ma 'dod yon snang zhing srid pa'i lha klu mi ma yin: gnyug mar gnas pa'i 'dre srin bgegs rigs lan chags dang bcas pa'i 'dod 'byung gi ji ltar mkho ba'i mchod sbyin du gyur: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bhā ra sam+bhā ra hūm̐: oṃ a kā ro sogs nas phaṭa swā hā: mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'di: mang por ting nge 'dzin gyis spel: so sor thob pa sngags kyis byas: phyag rgyas pham rgyal 'thab rtsod med: yon bzhes 'dod pa'i bsam pa sgrubs: hūm̐ hrī: phrin las 'di la dad dang ma dad pa'i: 'das dang ma 'das sde brgyad mi min tshogs: mgon skyabs grogs mdzad gnod byed lan chags sogs: kun kyang bden tshig rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon: bdag gi 'dod don phrin las sgrub pa 'dir: mgon skyabs grogs mdzad bsrung phyir mchod pa bzhes: ma dad bgegs rigs lan chags 'dod yon khyer: yongs khyab lha srin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: gang bsam 'dod don 'bras bu lhun grub mdzod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes bde chen gnam chen brag dkar na sbas pa'i shog ser las klong gsal snying pos bshus te yi ge pa ni bkra shis blo gros so// maṅga laṃ/// /
